title: Elastic Compression in Chronic Venous Disease
brief_summary: Patients with chronic venous disease causing pain or ache will be randomised into two groups, active stockings (18-21 mmHg) or placebo stockings
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Primary varicose veins causing pain/ache located only at the calf level

Exclusion Criteria:

* Venous ulceration
* Dermatitis
* Itching
* Superficial vein thrombosis
* Peripheral arterial disease
* Symptoms of non-venous origin
* Previous use of elastic stockings
